about: The land acknowledgement on the new-world title (title-intro.mjs), set like a film's opening card: each stanza a list of lines, shown as written. The title names the panel for screen readers; it is not shown. Pauses hold a breath after a word: which time it appears (from 1) and the ms, replacing any shorter punctuation or stanza breath after it and any punctuation touching it.
title: Before this forest
stanzas: Before our forest, there was land.
Before our story, there were peoples;
and who care for them still.
of the lands beneath our homes
and beneath the machines we built,
and the countless voices, old and living,
whose stories taught those machines — and us — to tell our own.
We offer back a carved wooden box,
Open the box. The path is yours.
